annotations.title: Get Market Environment of Company's Industry

description: Get the market environment of the company's industry (NAICS classification, else PKD 2007 class): a one-sentence summary (favourable / unfavourable / mixed / stable) and up to 4 strongest, non-overlapping indicators, each with a headline, a concrete observation with figures, effect on the company (positive/negative/neutral), source and the time series. Indicators: revenue growth and net margin of comparable companies computed from KRS financial statements, demand (sales/services volume, output), prices and bankruptcies from Monitly (Eurostat, GUS), latest-month GUS retail prices of what the company or its industry sells. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP; sole proprietors (CEIDG) by NIP, matched by their main PKD class.

lang.description: Language of summary and observations (default pl).

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.
